
```{devoirs_choices uniform_distribution_8_two_choices}
- A range-based model in which all permitted values are equally likely.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A distribution used when the value is bounded but could be anywhere within those bounds.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A model that assigns positive probability to every value on the number line.:
    correct: false
    feedback: A uniform distribution in this chapter is bounded; values outside its
      range are impossible.
- A list of observations ranked from most to least likely.:
    correct: false
    feedback: A uniform distribution gives equal likelihood across its range, not
      a ranking of observed data.
- A distribution whose endpoints are merely unlikely but still possible.:
    correct: false
    feedback: The uniform model's known range excludes values outside the bounds,
      unlike a normal model's soft tails.
```
